action_summary: Restore the equal-weight five-fold probability ensemble that scored 0.36763 in v21 versus 0.35115 for the current fold4-only version. Load and release checkpoints sequentially, use batches of eight with per-batch right-padding removal, reuse the tokenizer, and concatenate batch predictions once to bound memory and reduce overhead. Preserve checkpoint architecture, tokenizer, text concatenation, truncation, Kaggle paths, and continuous sigmoid outputs; add missing-text handling and explicit qa_id submission alignment with shape, finiteness, and range checks. No training or inference was run, and a new leaderboard improvement cannot be verified without competition data.
